branch_title: Joey Takes the Piece Mia Was Using

selected_option.choice_text: Reach over and take the piece Mia was using

sequence.text: Mia felt surprised and upset because you took the piece she was using.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: If you want to move closer, you should ask first.

sequence.text: You forgot to ask, even though Mia was still using the piece.

sections.heading: What Happened Before?
sections.body: A few minutes later, you spotted the perfect block in Mia's building area. It would fit perfectly on your tower.

sections.heading: What Did You Pick?
sections.body: Reached over and took the piece Mia was using

sections.heading: What Happened After?
sections.body: Mia felt surprised and disappointed. She did not want to keep playing.

sections.heading: Let's Talk
questions: Why was Mia extra surprised this time?
Why should we ask before taking a friend's toy?
How do you think Mia felt when you took the block without asking?
